description: Find by text/label/value/role/id and run action. The role locator matches snapshot kind vocabulary (button, text, text-field, switch, ...); pre-reconciliation leaf spellings (statictext, edittext, textview) stay accepted on the nodes that carried them during a deprecation window. Times out after 90s.

androidDeviceAllowlist.description: Android serial allowlist used for device resolution.

device.description: Device name selector (a UDID belongs in udid, a serial in serial).

deviceTarget.description: Device target form. Maps to the CLI --target flag.

includeCost.description: Include per-command agent-cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) in structuredContent. Defaults to off; the default response shape is unchanged.

mcpOutputFormat.description: MCP text content format. Defaults to optimized agent-friendly text; use json for JSON text. Structured content is always returned separately.

platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

record.description: Force-record this out-of-band observation into a repair-armed heal (mutually exclusive with noRecord). Authored replay steps are recorded automatically and never need this. On find, valid only for a read-only action.

responseLevel.description: Response verbosity: token-cheap digest / default (today) / full. Defaults to default; the default response shape is unchanged.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial selector.

target.description: Alias for deviceTarget on commands without a UI target field. Interaction commands reserve target for the UI element.

udid.description: Apple device or simulator UDID; the selector that pins one device when several share a name.

name: find

outputSchema.description: Daemon response data for the find command.

nodeCount.description: Number of nodes in the original node tree when the response carries one.

runnerRoundTrips.description: Number of real runner round-trips made while serving the request.

wallClockMs.description: Total wall-clock time for the request in milliseconds.

found.description: Whether a wait/exists/read-only find satisfied its condition.

locator.description: Locator kind used for the find action.

matches.description: Every match for the read-only find list action (#1625): { ref, node } each.

items.description: One listed match with its snapshot ref and node.

message.description: Diagnostic message for mutating find actions.

query.description: Query argument used for the find action.

ref.description: Snapshot ref without the @ prefix when the find action returns one.

refsGeneration.description: ADR 0014 ref frame epoch for read-only find actions.

text.description: Text value returned by find get_text.

waitedMs.description: Milliseconds waited for a read-only find condition.

x.description: Resolved x coordinate for mutating find actions.

y.description: Resolved y coordinate for mutating find actions.
